title: PR #1 — Verify prerequisites, initialize the repository, and write the agent context
description: Establish project readiness before any feature code: verify Cloudflare access and resources, create placeholder secrets, initialize the git repository with conventions, and write the AGENTS.md contract that every later PR must follow. Requirement IDs: TASK-1, TASK-57, TASK-58.
acceptanceCriteria: `.env.local` exists with placeholder entries for every environment variable name listed in the PRD, and `.dev.vars` mirrors it
Real secret values are not written to the PRD, task specs, repository, logs, or chat
The user has manually filled required local secret values in `.env.local` and `.dev.vars`
`wrangler whoami` returns the intended Cloudflare account, or the missing access is recorded with a user-approved proceed/block decision
D1 database exists and its id is recorded in `wrangler.jsonc`, or creation is recorded as a blocker
KV namespace for sessions exists and its id is recorded
Git repository is initialized, `main` is the integration branch, and the initial commit is clean
`.editorconfig` fixes UTF-8, LF, 2-space indent, final newline, and trim-on-save
Conventional Commits and the `type(scope): summary` PR title format are documented
`AGENTS.md` states the verify commands, architecture invariants, file layout, required reading, and secret policy
`AGENTS.md` links to the PRD, PR plan, and task index instead of duplicating them
`AGENTS.md` lists the project skills under `.agents/skills/` and states that `/preflight` runs before any PR is opened
The bootstrap-admin path is documented, and no password or recovery key is stored in the repository

steps.details: Open `.agent/prd/PRD.md` §7. List required accounts, resources, secrets, docs, and test users. Note every item marked 'unverified'.

Confirm `.env.local` contains SESSION_SECRET, AUTH_PEPPER, TOTP_ENC_KEY, APP_ORIGIN, TOTP_ISSUER, APP_ENV, CLOUDFLARE_D1_DATABASE_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_SESSIONS_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_RATE_LIMIT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET_NAME, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Create `.dev.vars` with the same names. Add missing names with `TODO_FILL_MANUALLY` only.

steps.description: Confirm local secret values are filled manually
steps.details: Ask the user to confirm they filled real values. Do not print, copy, or commit them. Provide the commands for the user to run themselves: `openssl rand -base64 32` for SESSION_SECRET, AUTH_PEPPER, TOTP_ENC_KEY.
Run `npx wrangler whoami`. Confirm the account id matches CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. If not authenticated, record `wrangler login` as the blocker and ask for a proceed/block decision.

steps.description: Create and verify D1 and KV resources
steps.details: Run `npx wrangler d1 create bridgewarden-db` and `npx wrangler kv namespace create KV_SESSIONS`. Record returned ids in `wrangler.jsonc` and the matching `.env.local` keys. Verify `npx wrangler d1 execute bridgewarden-db --local --command "SELECT 1"` succeeds.

Run `git init -b main`, create `.gitignore` covering `.env.local`, `.dev.vars`, `.wrangler/`, `build/`, `node_modules/`, coverage and Playwright artifacts, and `.editorconfig` with `charset = utf-8`, `end_of_line = lf`, `indent_style = space`, `indent_size = 2`, `insert_final_newline = true`, `trim_trailing_whitespace = true`. Make the initial commit `chore: initialize repository`. Confirm `git status` is clean and that seeding `.env.local` does not show up as untracked.

Add a short `CONTRIBUTING.md` section: Conventional Commits for commit messages, PR titles `type(scope): summary`, one requirement group per PR, and the PR body template (what changed, requirement IDs, how verified, risk/rollback, screenshots for UI).

Create `AGENTS.md` at the repo root covering: required reading order (`.agent/prd/PRD.md`, `.agent/prd/PR-PLAN.md`, `.agent/tasks.json`), verify commands (`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test:e2e`) marked as available from PR #2, architecture invariants (crypto client-only, no vault plaintext server-side, no ciphertext in SSR HTML, no third-party scripts, secrets only in `.dev.vars`), file layout to be created in PR #2, PR conventions, and the rule that requirement IDs are cited in PR bodies. Keep it under ~120 lines and link rather than duplicate.
Append a short note in `docs/readiness.md` or the PR description listing each prerequisite, its status, and any user-approved gaps. Do not include secret values.

technicalNotes: This task gates implementation. Do not start dependent feature tasks until prerequisites are verified or explicitly approved as gaps.
PR #1 creates repository scaffolding only: no `package.json`, no application source, no dependencies.
Wrangler reads local secrets from `.dev.vars`, not `.env.local`; both files must be gitignored.
Free-tier D1 caps a database at 500MB, which is sufficient for family scale.
No MCP server is required for this project.
AGENTS.md must not contain secret values, real account ids, or database ids.

pullRequest.title: chore: verify prerequisites, initialize repo, and add agent context
pullRequest.scope: Prerequisite checklist, wrangler resource ids, git init, .gitignore, .editorconfig, CONTRIBUTING conventions, AGENTS.md, readiness note.
pullRequest.outOfScope: package.json, application source, dependencies, schema, lint/CI implementation (PR #2).
